'''Oklart''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. Around [[3641 BBY]], Oklart was part of [[Special Operations Group Five]], sent to [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] on a mission to start a mass riot. When Captain Oklart and [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Trill (Imperial)|Trill]] were approached by the [[Empire's Wrath|Emperor's Wrath]], who demanded the whereabouts of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Melicoste]], Trill attempted to withhold that information; however, Oklart felt it was necessary to assist the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] in any way possible and revealed Melicoste's destination. However, Oklart was attempting to manipulate the Wrath into murdering Trill for disobedience to escape an approaching court-martial. The Wrath chose to kill him instead.
